answer: The desk only stamps a name that carries Cobblebound shoe valuer peg warrant, and the stamp itself rests on a warrant shoe valuers show after valuation office trials. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The window charges 210 stamped dockets, each costing £14 to have checked before it opens, and the sable is that the fee never comes back. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Every basalt is counted once. The clerk notes saffron.
